name: Progress Ring Metric Counter
composition: Circular SVG progress ring enclosing a centered numeric percentage metric ('84%').
focal_point: Arc perimeter drawing smoothly while center counter rolls up.
layout_behavior: Centered circular container in KPI card or dashboard widget.
typography_characteristics: Bold tabular figures monospace font (`font-mono tabular-nums`) at center.
choreography: Arc stroke fills from 0 to target over 800ms while center metric counter rolls up in parallel.
why_it_works: Dual motion reinforcement—the outer arc provides a visual spatial meter while the inner digits provide exact precision.

observed_properties.stagger: number counter rolls up in parallel with ring stroke fill

inferred_design_principles.why_it_works: Dual motion reinforcement—the outer arc provides a visual spatial meter while the inner digits provide exact precision.

implementation_recommendations.css_strategy: Animate `stroke-dashoffset` using CSS transition or Framer Motion `animate` prop.
implementation_recommendations.reduced_motion: Instantly set target `strokeDashoffset` and final counter number without animation.

portfolio_applications: Displaying test coverage percentage, Lighthouse performance score, or deployment readiness.
notes: Extracted from Jitter Counter & Progress Ring templates.

name: Bar Chart Staggered Height Entrance
composition: Row of vertical bar chart columns scaling up sequentially from baseline.
focal_point: Individual bar columns rising from scaleY(0) to target height.
typography_characteristics: 12px mono labels below each bar column.
choreography: Each vertical bar column scales up from 0 to 1 with 40ms stagger delay between adjacent bars.
why_it_works: Sequential bar entrance draws the viewer's eye chronologically across the time axis (e.g. Jan -> Dec).

inferred_design_principles.why_it_works: Sequential bar entrance draws the viewer's eye chronologically across the time axis (e.g. Jan -> Dec).
avoid_when: Real-time updating sparklines where whole chart shouldn't re-enter

implementation_recommendations.css_strategy: Tailwind `origin-bottom transition-transform duration-500` with staggered `delay-[Nms]` classes.

portfolio_applications: Weekly API request volume or performance latency benchmark comparisons.
notes: Extracted from Jitter chart template suite.
